verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for a developer CLI, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no assistant inside mise itself. `mise mcp` runs an MCP server that lets an external AI assistant inspect the project and run tasks, which is an adjacent capability rather than an in-product assistant. Installing claude-code through mise is only a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
